status: Model-conditional acquisition bridge plus exact indistinguishability constructions; no physical validation

requirements: Trusted pump-off covariance with all bath occupations equal and no pump excess diffusion
Same instantaneous invertible S and independent sensor covariance kernel across pump/reference
Reference and target drift known with a calibrated clock and log branch/continuous lag
No hidden loss bath omitted from the occupation reference

pump_sensor_alias.scope: All Gaussian process laws and all controlled occupation settings match; no passive data volume resolves internal pump versus invariant sensor OU noise.

energy_scope: These are bath number currents. Heat requires a supplied physical energy observable; for local single-mode bath i, multiply by hbar omega_i. Pump power, source inefficiency and material absorption are not inferred by these covariance checks.
physical_contract: Full instantaneous complex-quadrature readout; fixed invertible transduction S
Known common occupation shift of ALL dissipative bath contributions: deltaD=delta_n K
Hurwitz G and unique stationary covariance
Fixed H,K,Qi,Dp during thermal settings; no pump-induced drift of detector noise
Time-lag data with calibrated time/phase and branch control
Trusted sensor reference or temporally white sensor if absolute heating/current is sought
